meta.title: The Writer's Studio — Seven and a Half
meta.description: Work one-on-one with an accomplished journalist or editor. Learn to use AI as an editorial tool without letting it become your voice. Develop an original, publication-ready piece from idea to final edit.

hero.label: The Writer's Studio
hero.heading: Find your voice in the age of AI
hero.subheading: Work one-on-one with an accomplished writing mentor. Learn to use AI as a tool, not a ghostwriter. From a spark of an idea to a published byline, develop an original piece that is distinctly your own.

pillars.heading: Write with a writer
pillars.body: Work one-on-one or in a small group with an experienced journalist, editor, or published author. Every participant is matched with an Editorial Mentor whose background fits their project.

pillars.heading: Use AI without losing your voice
pillars.body: Learn where AI can help brainstorming, research organisation, interview preparation, revision prompts and where human judgment, reporting, originality, and style need to take over.

pillars.heading: Create something publishable
pillars.body: Develop an interview, reported article, personal essay, cultural commentary, or profile. The goal is a finished piece you are proud to put your name on.

pillars.heading: Earn a byline
pillars.body: Exceptional work may be selected for publication in New Voices, the Seven and a Half emerging-writers section. Publication is an editorial possibility, not a guarantee which is what makes it meaningful.

programs.label: Program options
programs.heading: Choose your track
programs.subheading: All programs are for writers 18 and older. Each includes direct sessions with your Editorial Mentor and structured feedback at every stage.

items.name: Editorial Consultation
items.description: A single focused session with an Editorial Mentor. Bring a draft, a pitch, or an idea. Leave with a clear editorial direction and a concrete next step.

features.text: AI-use guidance for your specific project

items.name: Article Program
items.description: Four sessions to develop a single piece from first idea to final draft. Ideal for a reported article, personal essay, or interview. The most popular track.

features.text: Editorial review for New Voices consideration

items.name: Idea to Byline
items.description: The full program. From raw idea to publication-ready piece, with structured editorial support at every stage. For writers who want to go deep.

features.text: Priority editorial review for New Voices

mentors.label: Editorial Mentors
mentors.heading: Who you will work with
mentors.body: Every Editorial Mentor is an accomplished journalist, editor, or published author. They are matched to participants based on subject expertise, writing form, and project type not just availability.

aiNote.label: Our approach to AI
aiNote.heading: AI is a tool. You are the writer.
aiNote.body: The The Writer's Studio does not teach AI writing. It teaches writing in a world where AI exists. Participants learn to use AI for brainstorming, research organisation, interview preparation, and revision and to recognise exactly where human judgment, voice, and originality need to take over. Every finished piece is the author's own work.

apply.heading: Ready to start?
apply.subheading: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Tell us about your project and the kind of writing you want to do.
